_comment: Dominic Pizza (slug dominic-pizza), York — LumiPOS customer (full EPOS on a Sunmi T2: counter sales, cash drawer, Z report). NOT YET REBRANDED. Every value below is still Acomb Pizza & Kebab House's, copied wholesale from data/shops/acomb-pizza-kebab on 17 Sep 2026 so the Cloudflare project could be stood up and the T2 installed before Dominic's own details arrived. See _comment_rebrand.
_comment_rebrand: MUST ALL CHANGE BEFORE THIS SHOP TAKES A REAL ORDER. Still Acomb's: tradingName, shortName, the whole address block, phone, email, domain, logo.png, assets/, index.html (the landing page is built around Acomb's reference visual), order.css, and every one of the 141 menu items in menu.json + menu-visual.json. prelaunch is ON so none of it can reach Google in the meantime. The build already warns about legalName, companyNumber and stripe.connectedAccountId because those were never filled in for Acomb either - do not read a quiet build as a finished rebrand, because the fields that are WRONG rather than missing cannot warn.
_comment_product: LumiPOS, unlike Acomb which is LumiWEB. pos.ordersOnly has been REMOVED from the copy: Dominic is buying the full EPOS, so the T2 must show the counter mode bar and the card-reader tile. Leaving Acomb's ordersOnly:true would have hidden the counter sales this shop is paying ~£35/wk for. See docs/PRODUCTS.md.

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name (e.g. 'Pizza Bob's' instead of 'Pizza Bob's Burgers Ltd').

_comment_theme: Brand red and gold sampled from the owner's reference visual. background/surface are the PLATFORM's light surfaces and must stay light: order.html, thank-you.html, reset-password, privacy, terms, allergy-info, the staff manifest and the confirmation email all paint dark ink on them without checking. They were briefly set to this shop's near-black, which rendered every one of those dark-on-dark — invisible headings on the thank-you page and invisible body text in the confirmation email. The DARK landing page is bespoke (data/shops/acomb-pizza-kebab/index.html) and now hardcodes its own #0a0a0a / #141414 rather than borrowing these. chrome stays dark so the staff PWA's theme_color is unchanged.

delivery._comment_enabled: OFF until Dominic's own delivery areas are confirmed. It is NOT off because the shop doesn't deliver - it is off because what was inherited here is Acomb Pizza & Kebab House's: four hand-drawn polygons over Acomb, Poppleton, Rufforth, Bishopthorpe and Clifton, which is the far side of York from 3 Lawrence Street (YO10, just outside the walls to the east). Left enabled it would price and accept deliveries against a map centred three miles away, and the shop's own postcode may not even sit inside any of the zones. Replace the zones (or switch to outcode/radius mode) and set enabled back to true together - do not flip this one on its own.

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order platform fee in pence. Charged to the customer and kept by the platform.
_comment_stripe: Stripe Connect: this site's PaymentIntents are created on the venue's connected account. connectedAccountId is the venue's acct_xxx string from Stripe Connect.

hours._comment: CONFIRMED BY THE OWNER, 17 Sep 2026: 4pm-3am every day, no closed day. 27:00 is 03:00 the NEXT morning - hours.js reads any close past 24:00 as rolling over, and 27:00 is the latest in the estate (the previous high-water mark was 25:00). ordering.businessDayStartHour stays 4, so the trading day runs 4am-4am and a 2am order is still counted against the night it belongs to.

ordering._comment_businessDayStartHour: Trading-day rollover hour (0–23, shop local time). 4 = the day's orders / takings / Z-report run 4am-to-4am, so a late-night shop's orders taken after midnight still count toward the day it opened. Set 0 for a plain midnight-to-midnight day. Safe to leave at 4 even for daytime shops (if you close before midnight there's nothing in the 0–4am window to reclassify).

_comment_promo: Standing offer agreed with the owner: 10% off EVERY online order with a subtotal of £12 or more (not a first-order welcome offer). minSubtotalPence is tested on the SUBTOTAL, before service fee and delivery. firstOrders stays off — the two do not stack and firstOrders would take precedence.

promo._comment_autoOnlineDiscount: CONFIRMED BY THE OWNER, 17 Sep 2026: 20% off the whole order over £15 (was Acomb's 10% over £12). percent and minSubtotalPence are the ONLY source of truth - totals.js applies them server-side and the landing page renders them through the {{promoPercentText}} / {{promoMinimumText}} tokens, so the advertised offer cannot drift from the one given. The minimum is measured on the SUBTOTAL, before the service fee and delivery. No menu item carries noPromo, so the discount really does apply to the whole basket.

_comment_pos: Till behaviour flags (all optional, default off). requireOrderPin:true makes staff enter their operator code to START every order (walk-in/collection/delivery) — leave it false so staff take orders with no per-order PIN. NOTE: the manager/owner PIN on voids, refunds and cancellations is a SEPARATE gate and is ALWAYS required regardless of this flag. selfServeDrinks:true hides the till's drink picker; externalCardMachine:true marks the Card button as paid immediately for a shop using its own card terminal.

payments._comment_cvcThreshold: Order total (in pence) above which a customer paying with a saved card has to re-enter their CVV. Defends against account-takeover for higher-value orders. Set to 0 to never require CVC re-collection. £50 = 5000.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact the restaurant before ordering.

marketing._comment_metaPixelId: Meta (Facebook) Pixel ID from Events Manager (a numeric string). Set it to enable Facebook/Instagram ad conversion tracking: PageView on every customer page + Purchase on the thank-you page. Leave empty to keep the pixel off.

_comment_prelaunch: KEEPS THIS SHOP OUT OF GOOGLE. Every page sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex and robots.txt is Disallow-all. Non-negotiable while the site still carries Acomb Pizza & Kebab House's name, address and phone on a domain that is not theirs - indexing that would put a real shop's details under another shop's brand. Remove ONLY once the rebrand in _comment_rebrand is done.
_comment_seo: NO seo block - inherited from Acomb, which never had one. Before launch add cuisine, priceRange, addressRegion, description and ogImage, plus seo.geo {lat,lng} taken from the owner or Google Maps for the real shop. NEVER guess the coordinates: they are what puts Google's pin on the door.
